name: 60 FPS
author: SkylandersPS4 contributors
description: Plays at 60 FPS with elapsed-time simulation (the 60-delta patches, adapted from the Wii U FPS pack by Mew00, SuperSamus and Winner Nombre). Automatic keeps menus, cutscenes and portal arrival at 30 and switches gameplay to 60; turn it off for a fixed 60 cap.
